# Gunel Mammadzade

**Email:** gunel1mammadzade@gmail.com | gunelmemmedzade2006@gmail.com  
**Phone:** +90 5016618761  
**Location:** Istanbul, Turkey  
**GitHub:** https://github.com/GunelMammadzade  

---

## Summary
Mathematical Engineering student at Yildiz Technical University with hands-on experience building dynamic web apps and browser-based games. Particularly passionate about frontend development, focusing heavily on JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3, while possessing foundational knowledge of Python and C#. Solid problem-solving and analytical background developed through rigorous engineering coursework, mathematics competitions, and professional training programs including SOCAR Türkiye NextGen Academy and Sprints x Microsoft.

---

## Education
- **Yildiz Technical University** (Oct 2023 – Jul 2027)
  - Bachelor of Science in Mathematical Engineering, Istanbul, Turkey

---

## Project Experience

### 1. YummyBox E-commerce Dynamic Web Application (Sep 2025 – Feb 2026)
- Engineered a responsive e-commerce web application using Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), Semantic HTML5, and modern CSS3 with a mobile-first design system.
- Built a persistent client-side shopping cart utilizing LocalStorage for instantaneous price and total calculations.
- Integrated WhatsApp Business API for automated order processing, translating structured cart items into instant checkout messages.

### 2. Secret Santa Game — Interactive Point and Click Game (Dec 2025 – Feb 2026)
- Developed a browser-based point-and-click game featuring complex DOM manipulation, animated interactive elements, and asynchronous sound cues.
- Designed a 4-digit keypad puzzle engine featuring custom input validation and state management.
- Built a dynamic viewport scaling engine guaranteeing a fixed 16:9 aspect ratio and seamless responsiveness across any screen size.

### 3. Travel Agency Landing Page (Oct 2024 – Jan 2025)
- Architected a high-performance landing page adhering to clean Semantic HTML5 structure and modern CSS Grid & Flexbox layouts.
- Structured styling using the BEM methodology to ensure scalable, modular, and maintainable styles.
- Implemented interactive navigation menus and external travel resource deep-linking to maximize conversion rate.

### 4. Desktop Calculator App (C# / WinForms) (Aug 2023 – Sep 2023)
- Engineered a multi-functional desktop calculator application using C# and .NET WinForms with an ergonomic, color-coded UI.
- Developed an arithmetic computation engine utilizing switch-case state machines for complex multi-operand calculation flows.
- Implemented event-driven architecture to seamlessly synchronize user interactions with calculation logic.

---

## Technical Skills
- **Languages:** JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, C#, Python, SQL
- **Frontend:** HTML5 (Semantic), CSS3 (Flexbox/Grid, Animations), React, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, DOM Manipulation, LocalStorage
- **Methodologies & Architecture:** BEM (Block Element Modifier), Mobile-First Responsive Design, Event-Driven Programming
- **Tools & Platforms:** Git, GitHub, MySQL, .NET WinForms, REST APIs, WhatsApp API, VS Code

---

## Certifications & Training Programs
- **Next Gen Academy Program** — SOCAR Türkiye
- **Full-Stack Web Development Training Program** — Sprints x Microsoft
- **Online Coding Training and Examination** — Bogazici University
- **ADA Business Marathon Participant** — ADA University
- **Canadian Open Mathematics Challenge (COMC)** — Canadian Mathematical Society

---

## Awards & Honors
- **Bronze Award — American Mathematics Olympiad** (STEM Education Research Center)
  - Placed in the top 20% of 1,500+ international contestants (2022).
  - Solved advanced proof problems in number theory and Euclidean geometry.
- **Bronze Award — IQ FISO** (Future Intelligence Student Olympiad)
  - Awarded Bronze Medal for excellence in logical deduction, creative problem-solving, and analytical intelligence.

---

## Languages
- **Russian:** C2 (Fluent / Native Proficiency)
- **English:** C1 (Advanced) | IELTS: 7.0, SAT: 1450
- **Azerbaijani:** Native / Bilingual
- **Turkish:** B2 (Conversational / Working Proficiency)
- **German:** A2 (Elementary / Pre-Intermediate)
